summary: AIProviderClient.toolCall is a clean additive implementation that mirrors the streamCompletion sanitize discipline (not the unsanitized extractSingleChunk pattern), correctly forces a single tool invocation via tool_choice, scans all content blocks for the first tool_use, and routes every error string through sanitize before throwing. The fixture is valid JSON, structurally matches InsightSkeleton, and covers 4 distinct SectionType values with one section carrying a non-empty deepDiveTopics array. All Decision 1 / Decision 8 acceptance criteria for Task 1 are satisfied.

suggestions.suggestion: The three parseError throw sites (L722, L730, L735) wrap static literals in sanitize(). Since these literals contain no apiKey substring, the call is a no-op today. This is acceptable as forward-defense (if a future edit interpolates dynamic content, sanitize is already in place), but consider a brief inline comment noting the intent so a future contributor does not delete the call as 'unnecessary'.
suggestions.benefit: Preserves sanitize-at-throw-site invariant against future regressions without changing runtime behavior.

suggestions.suggestion: URLSession network/timeout errors from `session.data(for: request)` propagate raw (mirrors extractSingleChunk per task spec edge-cases section). This is intentional and consistent with the rest of the file, but a one-line comment near the await — explicitly stating 'URLSession errors propagate unwrapped; they do not include request body so apiKey cannot leak' — would document the security reasoning for future reviewers.
suggestions.benefit: Makes the 'why no try-catch around session.data' decision auditable without re-deriving it from the task spec.

suggestions.suggestion: Sections without deep-dive topics use explicit `"deepDiveTopics": null`. The InsightSection Codable shape declares `deepDiveTopics` as optional, so omitting the key entirely also decodes correctly and is the more idiomatic JSON. Either form works; explicit null is fine if the intent is to make the schema shape obvious to a hand-tracing reviewer (which is the fixture's stated purpose), so this is purely stylistic.
suggestions.benefit: Slightly smaller fixture; matches typical Codable encoding output if the fixture is ever regenerated from a real Codable round-trip.

reviewNotes.apiKeyNeverInErrors: PASS — sanitize is invoked at every throw site that could carry the key. Static-literal sanitize calls are no-ops today but defensively correct. URLSession raw errors propagate but per task spec edge-cases section those carry no request body.
reviewNotes.errorHandlingReuse: PASS — only existing AIProviderError cases used (noAPIKey, httpError, parseError). No new toolCallError case added; the optional addition allowed by task spec was deemed unnecessary, which is the cleaner choice.

Section 'design-decisions' carries a non-empty deepDiveTopics array of 2 entries each with {id,label,hint,scopeHint} matching DeepDiveTopic Codable shape. Every section provides the required non-optional metadata dict.
